description.en: Specifies whether to filter by seat assignment.

description.zh: 成员名称模糊过滤（匹配 accountName 或 email，忽略大小写）
description.en: Fuzzy filter by member name. Matches accountName or email and is case-insensitive.

The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: 成员状态过滤（如 ACTIVE、FROZEN），null 表示不过滤
description.en: Filters by member status, such as ACTIVE or FROZEN. Set to null to disable filtering.
